_comment: Example global data in the format the server sends. Places are real Gainesville parks, but the amenities, descriptions and trail routes are made up / approximate for testing. Trails here use gpx_file (relative to this file); the server sends the GPX text as gpx. Load with: python global_database.py load sample_global_locales.json

trails.name: Gainesville-Hawthorne Trail
trails.description: Paved rail trail from Depot Park east past Boulware Springs

trails.name: Hogtown Creek Greenway
trails.description: Boardwalk and dirt trail along the creek

trails.name: Sweetwater Wetlands loop
trails.description: Loop around the wetlands; watch for alligators
